WITH RECURSIVE affected_modules(module_id) AS (
  SELECT subject_id AS module_id
  FROM module_depends_on_package
  WHERE object_id = 'package:legacy-money'
  UNION
  SELECT mdm.subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
  JOIN affected_modules am ON mdm.object_id = am.module_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
FROM service_implements_module sim
JOIN affected_modules am ON sim.object_id = am.module_id
JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sd ON sd.subject_id = sim.subject_id
JOIN deployments d ON sd.object_id = d.id
WHERE d.label = 'Production'
ORDER BY service_id
